title: Newsletter
content:
Everything above, once a week, in your inbox: the lead story, a Journal entry or two, and whatever series is currently running.

No sponsorships, no tracking pixels, and an unsubscribe link that actually works the first time.

title: About
content:
This site is technology, business, faith and the occasional story, written by one person who works across all four most weeks and rarely at the same desk twice.

The consulting work funds the fiction and the fiction keeps the consulting honest. The Journal is whatever did not fit anywhere else.
